title: Document Title Typographic Hierarchy (22.0pt vs 24.75pt)
coordinates: y0 = 62.26 pt, y1 = 145.35 pt (Page height 595.0 pt)
finding: The document title 'CardioTrack CT-200 Home Blood Pressure Monitor — Technical & User Manual' is rendered across three lines at exactly 22.00pt Bold (NimbusSans-Bold), not 24.75pt. Main section headings (H1) are 16.50pt Bold, subsections (H2) are 12.87pt Bold, and body is 11.00pt.
hierarchy_impact: Any heading parser looking for 24pt+ title will fail to capture the title block or misclassify it. The three-line title block must be grouped into a single H0 document title node.
intended_handling: Define H0 threshold at font_size == 22.0pt Bold and aggregate contiguous lines with y0 between 60pt and 150pt into a single title metadata field.

title: Table Header Cells Misclassified as Headings
coordinates: P2: 'Parameter', 'Value' at y0 = 76.06 pt, y1 = 91.21 pt; P4: 'Code', 'Meaning', 'Device Behavior' at y0 = 168.18 pt (v1) / y0 = 221.65 pt (v2)
finding: Table header cells ('Parameter', 'Value' on P2; 'Code', 'Meaning', 'Device Behavior' on P4) are typeset in 11.00pt Bold (NimbusSans-Bold). This exactly matches the font size and bold flag of genuine minor section headings (like 2.1.1.1 and 3.2).
hierarchy_impact: Heuristic extractors checking 'is_bold' or font size >= 11pt falsely insert table column names into the document table-of-contents tree as H3 sections.
intended_handling: Cross-check bounding boxes of bold text against detected table bounding boxes. Any text block residing inside a table structure must be routed to table cell extraction rather than heading generation.

title: Orphan Heading: Section 2 at Bottom of Page 1
coordinates: y0 = 530.36 pt, y1 = 553.08 pt (Page height 595.0 pt)
finding: The H1 heading '2. Physical and Electrical Specifications' (16.50pt Bold) is placed at the very bottom of Page 1 (y0 = 530.36 pt) with zero body text or subsection content following it. Subsection '2.1 General Specifications' begins on Page 2 at y0 = 43.68 pt.
hierarchy_impact: Per-page chunkers or parsers leave an empty H1 node on Page 1, and Page 2's H2 node lacks its H1 parent.
intended_handling: Detect orphan bottom headings (y1 > 520 pt with no trailing text) and forward-link them to bind as the parent section of the first block on the subsequent page.

title: Skipped Hierarchy Level: 2.1.1.1 Skips 2.1.1
coordinates: y0 = 252.41 pt, y1 = 267.56 pt (Page height 595.0 pt)
finding: Section 2.1 ('General Specifications') jumps directly to '2.1.1.1 Battery Life Under Typical Use' (11.00pt Bold). There is no parent section '2.1.1' anywhere in the manual.
hierarchy_impact: Strict document tree parsers expecting sequential hierarchy (L1 -> L2 -> L3 -> L4) will either crash, fail validation, or create an artificial empty intermediate container node.
intended_handling: Tolerate level skipping in hierarchy builder: attach 2.1.1.1 directly as a child of 2.1 without synthesizing phantom nodes.

title: v1 Section 3.1 Body Split Across Page 2 -> Page 3

(y0 = 543.63 pt). The remaining paragraph ('Use the profile button to select User 1 or User 2...') begins at the very top of Page 3 (y0 = 31.08 pt).
hierarchy_impact: In v1, a page-level chunker splits Section 3.1's procedure into two disconnected fragments.
intended_handling: Stitch paragraphs belonging to the same section across page boundaries when no new heading intervenes.

title: v2 Section 3.1 Becomes Pure Orphan Heading at Bottom of Page 2
coordinates: y0 = 528.25 pt, y1 = 545.97 pt (Page height 595.0 pt)
finding: In v2, downward revision text added in 2.1.1.1 pushes text downward. As a result, heading '3.1 Powering On and Profile Selection' sits at y0 = 528.25 pt as the very last line of Page 2 with ZERO body text underneath it! The entire body of 3.1 begins on Page 3 at y0 = 31.08 pt ('Press and hold the power button...').

title: Section 3.2 Typeset at 11pt Bold (Siblings are 12.87pt Bold)
finding: Heading '3.2 Cuff Inflation Sequence' is typeset at 11.00pt Bold (NimbusSans-Bold), whereas its sibling subsections (3.1, 3.3, 3.4) are all typeset at 12.87pt Bold. 11.00pt is identical to body text size.
hierarchy_impact: Classifiers relying solely on font size threshold (e.g. font_size >= 12.0pt) will fail to detect 3.2 as an H2 subsection, or will demote it below its siblings.
intended_handling: Implement hybrid heading classification combining regex section numbering ('^\d+\.\d+\s+') with bold formatting, overriding pure font-size heuristics.

title: Out-of-Order Section Numbering: Section 3.4 Appears Before 3.3
finding: Section '3.4 Auto Shutoff' (12.87pt Bold) is physically rendered before Section '3.3 Result Display and Classification' (12.87pt Bold) on Page 3 in both versions of the manual.
hierarchy_impact: Pure top-to-bottom geometric parsers produce an inverted document hierarchy (3.2 -> 3.4 -> 3.3), corrupting reading order and document tree structure.
intended_handling: Maintain both geometric layout order (for exact document fidelity) and logical section order (sorting siblings by canonical section number 3.3 before 3.4 in the index).

hierarchy_impact: In v1, an unhandled page break isolates Section 4 from its subsections 4.1 and 4.2.
intended_handling: Attach orphan heading at y0 > 500 pt to the top of Page 4.

title: Duplicate Heading 'Error Codes' at 4.2 and 7.1
finding: The exact heading string 'Error Codes' appears twice in both versions: 1) Section '4.2 Error Codes': Contains a structured table specifying error codes (E1–E5 in v1; E1–E6 in v2), their meanings, and automated device behavior. 2) Section '7.1 Error Codes': Contains narrative troubleshooting prose advising users what to do if an error code persists after retry prompts, explicitly cross-referencing Section 4.2 and support instructions.
hierarchy_impact: Parsers indexing or keying chunks solely by heading title ('Error Codes') will encounter a severe collision, overwriting or merging two completely distinct schemas (a reference table vs. user escalation instructions).
intended_handling: Enforce compound hierarchical keys (e.g. '4.2_Error_Codes' vs '7.1_Error_Codes') rather than bare heading text.

title: Cross-Page Sentence Split: Section 4.3 Across Page 4 -> Page 5

hierarchy_impact: Creates an unclosed qualifying clause on Page 4 and a dangling parenthetical phrase on Page 5.
intended_handling: Reconstruct split sentence across page boundaries by checking for open syntax/dangling prepositions.

title: Manufacturer Entity Anomaly in Section 6.2 (Anthropic vs CardioTrack)
finding: Section 6.2 states: 'Anthropic recommends professional recalibration every 2 years or after any drop or significant impact.' The manual elsewhere exclusively refers to CardioTrack as the manufacturer and support contact.
hierarchy_impact: Knowledge extraction pipelines will associate the maintenance policy with an unexpected entity (Anthropic) rather than the device brand (CardioTrack).
intended_handling: Preserve exact verbatim text during extraction, while noting the manufacturer entity discrepancy.

title: v2 Orphan Overflow Page 7 (Split Regulatory Statement)
finding: In v2, cumulative additions push Section 8.1 across the boundary: Page 6 ends with: 'The CT-200 is classified as a Class II medical device under applicable regulations for non-invasive blood pressure monitors and has been' and Page 7 contains only 82 characters: 'validated against relevant clinical accuracy standards for oscillometric devices.'
hierarchy_impact: Page 7 is an isolated 2-line fragment containing zero headings, zero metadata, and zero context. A naive page-level chunker creates a useless 14-word chunk.
intended_handling: Merge Page 7's trailing text back into Section 8.1 on Page 6.

title: Typography & Character Encoding: Ligatures and Non-Breaking Hyphens
finding: The PDFs embed special Unicode characters: LATIN SMALL LIGATURE FF (U+FB00: 'ﬀ'), LATIN SMALL LIGATURE FI (U+FB01: 'ﬁ'), LATIN SMALL LIGATURE FL (U+FB02: 'ﬂ'), NON-BREAKING HYPHEN (U+2011: '‑'), EN DASH (U+2013: '–'), EM DASH (U+2014: '—'), GREATER-THAN OR EQUAL TO (U+2265: '≥'), and PLUS-MINUS SIGN (U+00B1: '±').
hierarchy_impact: Keyword searches (e.g. for 'Cuff', 'Shutoff', 'CT-200', 'Profile') fail exact string matching if ligatures and non-breaking hyphens are not normalized. LLM tokenizers often split U+2011 as multiple tokens.
intended_handling: Apply NFKD Unicode normalization and explicit character replacement: U+FB00 -> 'ff', U+FB01 -> 'fi', U+FB02 -> 'fl', U+2011 -> '-'.

title: Lists and Bullet Points State
finding: There are exactly ZERO bullet points (no •, -, or * markers) anywhere in either document. There is exactly ONE numbered list in the entire document, located on Page 3 under Section 3.3 (Result Display and Classification), containing 5 clinical blood pressure categories: 1. Normal (< 120 and < 80); 2. Elevated (120-129 and < 80); 3. Hypertension Stage 1 (130-139 or 80-89); 4. Hypertension Stage 2 (>= 140 or >= 90); 5. Hypertensive Crisis (> 180 or > 120).
hierarchy_impact: Naive regex matching lines starting with numbers ('1. Normal') might misclassify clinical categories as top-level H1 document sections if font size is ignored.
intended_handling: Check font size (11.0pt regular) to treat items 1-5 as list items under Section 3.3 rather than H1 headings.
